RAMP ECONOMICS LAB
Ramp AI Index

Monthly measurement of AI adoption and spend across American businesses using transaction data from 85,000+ firms on Ramp.

DATA THROUGH OCT 2026

Summary

In the week ending November 1, 2026, Anthropic captured the largest share of AI token spending among businesses on Ramp, at 49.3%.

Total token spending rose 10.5% compared with the same week last month.

In October 2026, AI adoption reached 56.8% of U.S. businesses on Ramp, up 1.0 percentage points from September and 13.3 points from a year earlier.

Among firms paying for AI, the top 1% spent a median of $10,199.20 per employee per month on AI, compared with $16.32 for the median firm.
